svg.title: From tensor powers to the connective affine spectral diagonal
svg.desc: Normalized operator coefficients are finite projective by every tensor power and its dual. Two affine curve charts and the shifted Spencer columns make the full commutative-algebra left adjoint connective. The resulting pair algebra represents every derived diagonal fibre and is the quasicoherent diagonal unit pushforward. Global tensor comparison and localization remain required.
svg.text: The actual connective affine diagonal
Complex projective curve; arbitrary connective DG base; every higher path retained.
1. Normalize first; test every tensor power — CSD.1–CSD.7
u_A(M) = M_left[−1], u_A(ω_X ⊗ A) = O_XA
P = u_A E_z(V) is perfect; P⊗n and (P∨)⊗n have upper bound 1 for all n.
At a residue field, a positive top degree b would become nb under n tensor powers.
Dual powers exclude negative fibre degrees; the derived residue criterion gives
P a retract of a finite sum of unshifted R_A modules, with its actual connection.
2. Full curve pushforward preserves normalized connectivity — CSD.12–CSD.13
Spencer columns: u_A(M)[2] → (Ω¹_X ⊗ u_A(M))[1]
Column upper bounds: −2 −1
Two affine charts add Čech degrees 0 and 1; the total upper bound is 0.
All columns are finite; inputs and DG base coefficients may be unbounded below.
3. Retain the commutative-algebra bar — CSD.8–CSD.18
L_A(Q) = | [n] ↦ Sym_A(p_A,* Tⁿ UQ) |, T = U Sym_DA
Each free term is connective, and realization stays connective.
Map_CAlg_A(L_A(Q), B) = Map_CAlg(DA)(Q, ω_X ⊗ B), for all DG B.
For the regular Q_z,w, all-DG-algebra Yoneda gives D_z,w ≃ L_A(Q_z,w).
The whole algebra resolution imposes multiplication, unit and every higher relation.
4. Actual derived affine diagonal and full unit pushforward — CSD.19–CSD.25

D_z,w is connective; this square is Cartesian on all derived affine tests.
D_Δ = Δ_Z,* O_Z; QCoh(Z) ≃ Mod_DΔ(QCoh(Z × Z)).
5. The global comparison still required
π( (Loc ⊗ Loc)(R_R) ) ≃ Δ_Z,* O_Z is proved as a Cartesian algebra.
The equivalence of π and the localization right adjoint still require proofs.
Global projected generation, the ordinary projector and nilpotent regularity remain.
The geometric ground-field extension, tempered and microlocal obligations remain.
Solutions 3.BL–3.BN check the tensor-power obstruction, full free bar and torus fibre.
